Name: Garage recolor (For Yellog's Wood Buildings)
Author: morphinpink
Description:
This is a simple recolor of the garage asset of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Pathoschild's Tractor Mod[/url] to match [url=https://yellog.postype.com/post/11565362]Yellog's Wood Buildings[/url].


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZcLAPDj.png[/img][list=1]
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Pathoschild's Tractor Mod[/url]﻿﻿
[*]Download this mod, then unzip and drop this garage.png file in the assets folder of the tractor mod and replace it.
[/list][b]note this is a replacement png[/b]. if you want to keep a copy of the original garage, just change the name of the original garage file before dropping this recolor in the assets folder.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/XaxBwuY.png[/img]﻿
